verified_facts.text: Rosewood Cape Kidnappers is in Hawke's Bay, New Zealand.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rosewood Cape KidnappersHawke's Bay, New Zealand

verified_facts.text: The property is a 6,000 acre working sheep and beef farm, where guests can join the farmer and his trained farm dogs for a shepherding experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join our farmer and his highly trained farm dogs for an introduction to life on a 6,000 acre working sheep and beef farm

verified_facts.text: The clifftop golf course was completed in 2004 and sits in a ridge-and-valley landscape with sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Celebrated as a modern marvel since its completion in 2004, this remarkable clifftop New Zealand course is nestled in a ridge-and-valley landscape with arresting sea views.

verified_facts.text: The golf course was designed by Tom Doak.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Tom Doak–designed course is legendary

verified_facts.text: Vegetables, fruits and herbs harvested from the property's own garden shape the seasonal cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: The lush vegetables, fruits and herbs that are harvested from Rosewood Cape Kidnapper’s own garden, shape the seasonal cuisine

verified_facts.text: The Dining Room's menu highlights local seasonal produce and changes daily.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring menus that highlight local seasonal produce through delightful flavour combinations in a menu that changes daily.

verified_facts.text: Nature's Dining Room is a gourmet picnic hamper of local food and wine to enjoy out in the landscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the spectacular natural landscape with a gourmet picnic hamper filled with a curated selection of local food and wine.

verified_facts.text: Guests can also dine at the golf course clubhouse, which has a more casual menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests can dine at the clubhouse on the golf course with a more casual menu

verified_facts.text: Grand Ridge Junior Suites sit on a skyline ridge with views over the farm and the Pacific Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on a skyline ridge with stunning views over the farm and the Pacific Ocean

verified_facts.text: The Four Bedroom Villa is the largest accommodation on the property, with a sheltered courtyard, jacuzzi and outdoor barbecue, for up to 8 guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The largest accommodation on property features a sheltered courtyard, jacuzzi and outdoor barbecue. Perfect for large groups, suitable up to 8 guests.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have deep soaking tubs in front of picture windows overlooking the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Deep soaking tubs sit in front of picture windows overlooking the sea

verified_facts.text: The gannet colony is described as the largest, most accessible mainland colony of gannets in the world.
verified_facts.excerpt: the largest, most accessible mainland colony of gannets in the world

verified_facts.text: Cape Sanctuary night tours introduce guests to New Zealand's nocturnal wildlife.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the magic of Cape Sanctuary's night tour for an unforgettable journey into New Zealand's nocturnal wonders.

verified_facts.text: Cape Sanctuary daytime and nighttime tours are offered exclusively to Cape Kidnappers guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Both daytime and nighttime tours are offered exclusively to Cape Kidnappers guests.

verified_facts.text: There is a kaka aviary and feeding station in the woods near the main lodge.
verified_facts.excerpt: There's also a kaka aviary and feeding station in the woods near the main lodge.

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore the property with an experienced local on a Can-Am tour.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore the rugged beauty of Cape Kidnappers with an experienced local aboard a Can-Am

verified_facts.text: Winery tours visit Hawke's Bay vineyards and wineries.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take an unforgettable journey through the vineyards and wineries that make Hawke's Bay a Great Wine Capital of the World.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary activities change day to day and include flower-arranging classes, foraging workshops and farm tours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary activities change day to day and include options like flower-arranging classes, foraging workshops, and farm tours.

verified_facts.text: The property has an infinity-edge pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: My favorite amenity was the infinity-edge pool

verified_facts.text: The lodge followed the golf course in 2007, and Rosewood entered the picture in 2023.
verified_facts.excerpt: the luxury hotel followed in 2007, joining the Robertsons' other lodges Kauri Cliffs in Matauri Bay and Matakauri in Queenstown. Luxury hotel group Rosewood entered the picture in 2023.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are minimalist country-house chic, with lofted ceilings with timber trusses, off-white shiplap and barn doors.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooms are minimalist country-house chic: lofted ceilings with timber trusses, off-white shiplap, and barn doors.

verified_facts.text: There is no kids club; families can instead watch sheepdogs at work, go hiking and encounter native birds.
verified_facts.excerpt: don't expect a kids club. Instead, families can watch sheepdogs at work, go hiking, and meet encounter native birds throughout the property.

verified_facts.text: Guests typically fly into the small regional airport at Napier and drive along the coast and up into the hills.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fly into the little regional airport at Napier, drive through the city's Art Deco downtown, and continue along the coast and up into the hills until you reach Rosewood Cape Kidnappers

verified_facts.text: Spa treatment rooms are in a building just above the main lodge, with a terrace for tea after treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Quiet treatment rooms perfect for pampering line a hallway in a building just above the main lodge. Following your massage, sit on the terrace with a cup of tea.
